import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long sn = 10000000, sd = 1;
        for (int den = 1; den <= n; ++den) {
            long num = (x * den * 2 + y) / (2 * y);
            long diffCur = Math.abs(x * den - num * y);
            long diffBest = Math.abs(x * sd - sn * y);
            if (diffCur * sd < diffBest * den) {
                sn = num;
                sd = den;
            }
        }
        System.out.printf("%d/%d%n", sn, sd);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
